name: manual_e22860
claim: When a Portal source is unavailable, do not substitute realistic healthy state; label explicit demo fixtures in the relevant panel and keep effect controls disabled.

decisions.notes: At the earlier Orama static preview, mock health resembled production. A later captured demo correctly marked API unavailable and disabled preview and launch; sample readiness still looked live inside the panel. These were preview observations, not production qualification.
